integrity: Analytic proof and standalone reproducible finite checks are supplied; finite checks do not establish asymptotic claims; historical priority provisional.
scientific_claim: For a Haar-random fixed-distance section of a regular simplex, all fixed face counts jointly have a noncentral chi-square limit at offsets \(t=h/n\), a common Gaussian intermediate limit when \(n^{-1}\ll t\ll n^{-1/2}\), and a common Gaussian limit with corrected explicit variance when \(t=c/\sqrt n\).
scientific_limitations: Fixed face ranks, regular simplices, Haar-uniform fixed-offset hyperplanes, weak limits only; central h=0 law is prior work; no independent mathematical or historical-priority audit.
title: Noncentral chi-square-to-Gaussian crossover in regular-simplex section face vectors
